newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PNG confident of World Bank $345 million aid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PNG confident of World Bank $345 million aid.

text.p: Papua New Guinea finance minister Chris Haiveta said on Thursday that he was confident of reaching agreement with the World Bank over its US$345 million aid programme to the country.
Haiveta said World Bank officials were now in his country and he would hold talks with them at the end of September.
"I see no problem really with reaching a final agreement for the final tranche," Haiveta told reporters in Sydney. However, he could not give a time frame for such an agreement.

Australian newspapers have reported that the World Bank has treatened to cancel its aid programme because of changes to Papua New Guinea's foresty policy, which effectively restores control of the independent National Forest Authority to the minister for forests, contrary to the World Bank agreement.
Some experts believe logging in Papua New Guinea is being carried out at twice the sustainable rate.
